scenario_title_zh: 经编三贾卡与 TWONE 智能单双层

rounds.ai_message: David, we're redesigning our flagship performance shoe upper and exploring alternatives to standard circular mesh. How does Sintech's TWONE smart warp knitting technology outperform traditional 3D spacer mesh?
rounds.ai_message_zh: David，我们正在重新设计旗舰性能跑鞋鞋面，想寻找替代传统圆机网布的方案。信泰的 TWONE 智能经编技术相比传统 3D 三明治网布有哪些突破？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 推介 TWONE 智能单双层一体成型技术：实现局部单层透气、局部双层立体支撑，解决传统网布贴合溢胶和笨重问题
rounds.common_mistakes: 避免只讲抽象概念，要讲出 'seamless transition from single-layer mesh to double-layer structural support without secondary bonding'。
rounds.tips_zh: 母语亮点：'TWONE allows us to knit high-ventilation single-layer zones and robust double-layer containment zones on the very same machine bed.'
rounds.user_response_example: Traditional 3D spacer mesh requires hotmelt overlays or layered stitching for lateral support, which adds weight and compromises airflow. Our proprietary TWONE smart warp knitting utilizes advanced Karl Mayer multi-bar machines to engineer a seamless transition from a single-layer open mesh to a reinforced double-layer structure in one continuous piece. This gives the runner targeted breathability over the vamp and rigid lockdown at the heel counter without adding a single gram of glue.

rounds.ai_message: Eliminating overlays would save huge tooling costs. How is the run-resistance and seam burst strength if the upper experiences high lateral shear forces during sprinting?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 取消热熔膜能省下巨额模具费。如果鞋面在冲刺时承受剧烈的侧向剪切力，其防脱散性能和接缝顶破强力表现如何？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 解释经编独有的柱编链组织（pillar stitch）与防脱散特性，即使局部勾丝也不会顺向抽线，顶破强力超 800N
rounds.common_mistakes: 针织容易脱散是纬编弱点，要强调经编（Warp knit）每个线圈互相咬合锁死，'intrinsically ladder-proof'。
rounds.tips_zh: 母语亮点：'Unlike weft knits that unravel under puncture, warp knitting loops lock into adjacent wales, making it intrinsically ladder-resistant.'
rounds.user_response_example: That is the fundamental strength of warp knitting. Because each loop is anchored by an independent vertical pillar stitch across adjacent wales, TWONE is intrinsically run-resistant and ladder-proof — even if an open mesh cell is punctured, it will not run. In testing under ASTM D3787, our burst strength exceeds 850 Newtons, providing unmatched lateral shear stability during high-speed cuts.
